mapper.sql: id, title, category, content, keywords, priority, enabled, create_time, update_time, creator
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_base SET title = #{title}, category = #{category}, content = #{content}, keywords = #{keywords}, priority = #{priority}, enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_base WHERE enabled = true ORDER BY priority DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT FROM knowledge_base WHERE category = #{category} AND enabled = true ORDER BY priority DESC, create_time DESC

SELECT FROM knowledge_base WHERE enabled = true AND ( title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY priority DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT FROM knowledge_base ORDER BY priority DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
